Start with the source

A lasting solution begins with moisture control

Mold is usually a symptom of excess moisture—from a leak, condensation, poor ventilation or past water damage. Effective mold remediation goes beyond surface cleaning. The affected materials and the conditions that allowed growth need to be understood.

We help West Vancouver property owners move from uncertainty to a practical scope of work, with attention to containment, careful removal and cleanup.

Common questions

Mold remediation FAQ

What does mold remediation include?+

The process generally includes assessing the affected area, controlling moisture, isolating the work zone, removing contaminated material when necessary, cleaning, and confirming the area is ready for repair.

How quickly should mold be addressed?+

Mold and the moisture source should be investigated promptly. Delays can allow damp materials to remain affected and may increase the scope of work.

Can I clean mold myself?+

A very small surface area may sometimes be manageable, but recurring growth, hidden moisture, porous materials or a larger affected area can require professional assessment and containment. Avoid disturbing suspect material if you are unsure.

Do you serve all of West Vancouver?+

Service is focused on West Vancouver, including Ambleside, Dundarave, British Properties, Caulfeild, Horseshoe Bay, Eagle Harbour, Gleneagles and nearby neighbourhoods.
